input.prompt: Clean flat vector infographic for a website, wide landscape composition on a pure white background, corporate flat-design style with soft rounded shapes, matching a light blue and yellow illustration set. Show the six insurance document types that intelligent document processing handles as a grid of six identical rounded-square tiles, three columns by two rows, with even gutters. All six tiles have exactly the same pale blue #E7F0FB fill with no highlighted, selected, darker or lighter tile. Each tile has one simple line-and-fill icon centered in the upper two-thirds and one short bold navy label centered in the lower third, in a clean sans-serif font at a moderate size so every label fits on one line with clear padding. Icons contain no lettering. Tile 1: a claim form with a car and a small crack icon; label exactly 'Claims Forms'. Tile 2: an application form with a checkbox list and a pen; label exactly 'Policy Applications'. Tile 3: a document with a circular renewal arrow and a calendar; label exactly 'Policy Renewals'. Tile 4: a paper invoice with a table and a coin; label exactly 'Vendor Invoices'. Tile 5: a medical report page with a heart-pulse line and a clipboard; label exactly 'Medical Records'. Tile 6: a notepad page with handwritten wavy lines and a pencil; label exactly 'Adjuster Notes'. A single small yellow spark near the top-right corner. Palette: periwinkle blue #4A72D8, pale blue #C9DDF6, very light blue #E7F0FB, mustard yellow #F5B84A, navy #1F2A44, soft green #3BB273, white. Generous outer margins, crisp edges, no connecting lines, no arrows, no dotted lines. The only text in the image is the six labels, all bold and perfectly spelled.
